name: 85756 · Tucson, AZ
findings: ZIP 85756 (Tucson) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85756 (Tucson) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 85756 (Tucson) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 28 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.
